referenceState.name: IIR
referenceState.note: Relative enthalpy/entropy reference; heat and work use differences.

assumptions: Steady single-stage pure-R134a vapor-compression cycle; all specific quantities are per kg of circulating refrigerant.
No line or heat-exchanger pressure drop; negligible kinetic and potential energy changes.
State 1: saturated vapor at Te (no superheat). State 3: saturated liquid at Tc (no subcooling).
Adiabatic compressor: state 2s at Pcond and s1; eta=(h2s-h1)/(h2-h1). eta is compressor isentropic efficiency, not motor/electrical efficiency.
Adiabatic valve with no shaft work: h4=h3 at Pe; x4 is equilibrium vapor mass fraction, not gas volume fraction.
qL=h1-h4, w=h2-h1, qH=h2-h3 are positive magnitudes. COP=qL/w does not include fans, pumps, motor losses or controls.

Carnot comparison additionally assumes two constant-temperature reservoirs at Te and Tc, in kelvin. These are not measured room/product temperatures; no real finite heat-exchanger approach is modeled.
Only compressor endpoints and an isentropic reference endpoint are supplied. Any line joining endpoints is a schematic, not the actual internal trajectory.
No transient cooling, heat-transfer coefficient, equipment capacity, food process schedule, safety prediction, or refrigerant selection recommendation.
The saturation branches end at 95 degC, below the critical point; the dataset does not close the dome at the critical point.
Only listed grid values are computed. Interpolating them is not a new EOS flash and is not validated by this dataset.
